description: This Java source file defines a command handler class that processes delete commands for delinquency ranges in the Fineract loan portfolio module. It uses annotations for dependency injection and command type metadata, and implements a method to invoke a service for deleting delinquency ranges.

classes.name: DeleteDelinquencyRangeCommandHandler
classes.description: A service component that handles commands to delete delinquency ranges, implementing command processing interface with transactional support.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the delete command for a delinquency range by calling the write platform service.
